note: The status checks the branch ruleset makes a merge condition. Every entry in `contexts` is reported by a job in a workflow that triggers on pull_request with no trigger filter, so it reports on EVERY pull request — a check that never reports blocks the merge forever. Every entry in `codecov_contexts` is reported by Codecov once a pull request's uploads have arrived, so the uploads run on every pull request too. scripts/check-merge-gates.mjs enforces both from the workflow side; `pnpm check:gates --ruleset` diffs both lists against the live ruleset, which no token in CI is allowed to read.
integration_id_note: GitHub Actions' app id. A ruleset entry matches on the app as well as the context name, so an entry pinned to another app is satisfied by nothing these workflows can report, and one pinned to no app is satisfied by anything that reports the name.
codecov_integration_id_note: Codecov's app id, which the codecov/* check runs report under.
